verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents role-based access control, where privileges are granted to roles and roles to users, and cloned databases or schemas inherit the grants on their child objects. That covers object/table-level access by role. Nothing in the pack shows column-level masking policies or row-level access policies, which make up half of what the story asks for. Access History tracks which columns are read, but that is auditing, not access control, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: masking policies (column-level security), row access policies, multi-team isolation guidance, independent/hands-on corroboration.
